title: Characterization of stormwater at selected South Carolina Department of Transportation maintenance yards and section shed facilities in Ballentine, Conway, and North Charleston, South Carolina, 2010-12 [North Charleston facility, Charleston County]
citation: Journey, C.A., and Conlon, K.J., 2014, Characterization of stormwater at selected South Carolina Department of Transportation maintenance yards and section shed facilities in Ballentine, Conway, and North Charleston, South Carolina, 2010-12: U.S. Geological Survey Fact Sheet FS-2014-3011, map scale 1:33,000.
notes: Four-page fact sheet summarizing a stormwater water-quality study (SCDOT facilities at Ballentine, Conway, North Charleston; companion to SIR 2013-5175). No geologic units, borings, wells, structures or aquifer data. Its four references (impervious surfaces review, national stormwater database, SCDHEC water standards, EPA sampling guidance) are not geologic and were skipped.
